conviction_note: A Q3 upward revision with a dividend increase looks close to certain: H1 already covered 72.5% of full-year ordinary profit, the ~5.0bn yen DBJ fund #2 sale is booked in Q3, and 523 units were queued for Q3 sale. But IFIS consensus (ordinary 10,150m against the company's 8,771m) and the holders' board both already expect a revision, and the last H1 print was sold 10% as 'good but no surprise'. The edge left is small and positive: this name has closed up after both prior Q3 prints (+4.79%, +3.04%, both fading from larger gaps), and the stock is already down 11.9% over 20 days against about 5% for the sector. So the reaction is sized at +1.0, well under the 4.85% scale, while the fundamental read (print_vs_bar -2.0) puts the likely revision slightly below consensus.

findings.finding: Q3 should mechanically push cumulative profit to or past the full-year guide, making an upward revision plus a dividend increase (30% payout policy) very likely today. H1 ordinary profit was 6,361m, 72.5% of the 8,771m guide, and the company kept the guide unchanged, which implies H2 ordinary of only 2,410m, -7.6% year on year after H1 was +79%. The DBJ fund #2 transfer (191 units, ~5.0bn yen) is explicitly booked in Q3. At H1 the company said 144 contracted plus 379 on-sale vacant units were mainly for Q3 sale, against a whole-H2 renovation plan of only 618 units. My base case is Q3 OP around 2.5-3.2bn yen and cumulative ordinary around 8.8-9.4bn yen, which is 100-107% of the full-year guide. Last year the company revised at the Q3 print (2025-09-30, ordinary +20.5%) when cumulative Q3 ordinary had just passed the old full-year guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 print with a revision and dividend increase, 2025-10-01: gap +6.42%, close +3.04%. Q3 print 2024-10-01 (revision came later, 2024-12-19): +4.79%. The H1 prints without a revision were sold: 2025-07-01 -5.65% and 2026-07-01 -10.19% (kabutan: '好決算発表もサプライズ乏しく出尽くし感先行'). Stand-alone revisions were bought: 2025-05-23 +8.65% and 2026-05-14 +5.52%. So the name is bought when the guide moves and sold when it does not.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, which is why this is sized at +1.0. IFIS consensus ordinary 10,150m already sits 15.7% above the company guide, and the Yahoo board is openly waiting for the revision ('上方修正が出ないと再度の下げ'). What is not fully in the price: at 1,403 yen the stock trades at about 7.6x consensus EPS and 8.4x guide EPS, and it fell 11.9% in 20 days against -5.4% for the TOPIX real-estate ETF (1633.T) and -1.0% for TOPIX (1306.T). That prices a meaningful chance that the consensus revision does not come. If the market fully believed the Q3 arithmetic, the stock would have tracked the sector rather than falling twice as far into the print.
findings.independence: The 2025-09-30 precedent is a separate document: the revision at the Q3 print once cumulative ordinary 4,995m passed the old full-year 4,981m guide (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20250930/140120250929564052.pdf). The H1 presentation (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260630/140120260629582833.pdf) is the source for the Q3 unit pipeline and the H2 plan; it is a different document from the fund notice, but the same issuer. IFIS consensus (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=2975) points the same way but is the same arithmetic done by analysts, so it is not independent evidence about Q3.
